_comment: PCB-0017-A stereo-class-d-amp P2 merged constraint set (architect). Sources: research/power.json (power + thermal, wins on currents: 4 A in / 3 A out over requirements Q6's provisional 3 A), research/refdesign-amp.json (tie table, decoupling tiers, filter values), component-scout fragments (footprint sizes), state.json decisions (override research: TPA3118D2DAPR pad-down, 2 oz, no snubber, 10 uF in 0805, no protection). Prose in architecture/*.md. Canonical net names per architecture/sheets.md: bare +12V and GND; every other net is a root-sheet local label with a leading '/'.

power._basis: both channels clipping into 4 ohm at 13.2 V, 10 % THD (power.md table 3); 0.88 mm at 2 oz / dT 20 - draw >= 1.0 mm; >= 8 vias per layer change

return of the +12V budget on the B.Cu pour (plane_fed: no zone fill on GND = plane_missing error, the one gate that can enforce the heat spreader's existence at P7); pdn false because GND is a return, not a rail

power._note: the eight output nets: 3.1 A peak / 2.4 A rms at 13.2 V into 4 ohm (power.md table 3); 0.62 mm at 2 oz / dT 20 - draw >= 0.8 mm; >= 6 vias per layer change; the four /OUT* switch nodes stay on F.Cu, short and symmetric per channel

_diff_pairs_why: EXPLICIT empty list: auto-discovery would pair /SPK_L_P with /SPK_L_N (and _R_) as controlled-impedance differential pairs and demand gap/skew/coupling, which is the wrong frame for a 400 kHz BTL speaker output. What these nets need is per-channel SYMMETRY and minimum loop area (refdesign decision 13), which is a placement/routing rule (placement.groups filter_l / filter_r) not a diff-pair rule.
_voltages_why: nothing on the board exceeds 13.2 V (BTL outputs swing 0..PVCC); listed so check_creepage has the rail's ceiling on record; no pair is > 30 V apart, so no aiee_hv rule is expected

thermal._power_basis: design point: 8 ohm full power at 13.2 V / 10 % THD = 1.5 W; 4 ohm music 0.8 W. Sustained 4 ohm full-power sine (3.0-4.2 W) is recorded NOT a requirement (state.json P1 decision) and is left to the 150 C thermal shutdown, self-clearing via the FAULTZ-SDZ tie
thermal._dt_basis: Ta 40 C, Tj <= 125 C (10 C under the lowest OT trip) -> 85 C rise -> RthJA <= 56.7 C/W. power.md EST ~30 C/W for 44x34 mm two-sided 2 oz with the pad-down DAP; TI measured 22 C/W on its 2-layer EVM copper with no heatsink (SLOS708G 6.4). check_thermal's 2-layer screen floors at 73.8 C/W and will model a 111 C rise: waive at P8 against those two vendor numbers, never by lowering these
thermal._min_vias_basis: power.md section 4 (TI SLMA002 practice): 0.3 mm drill / 0.6 mm pad at ~1.1 mm pitch across the exposed pad (3.04 x 3.74 mm max) and the mask-covered thermal land P3 extends it to, plus stitching at GND pins 9/22/25/28; check_thermal counts GND vias within ~6.5 mm of U1's centroid, so the pin-ring vias count. Solid zone connection, no thermal relief. The check's own default would be ceil(hull_area/1.21) capped at 36 - too many for a 3 x 4 mm pad, hence explicit

edges._why: line in faces U1's pin 1-16 side (RINP/RINN pins 4/5 upper, LINP/LINN 10/11 lower); pads ordered R, GND, L top to bottom
right speaker: OUTNR/OUTPR are pins 27/29, the upper half of the pin 17-32 side
left speaker: OUTNL/OUTPL are pins 21/23, the lower half

12 V in lands beside C13 at PVCC 31/32 (top-right of U1 at rot 0); the trunk to PVCC 18/19 runs along the right/bottom edge outside the LC filters, never across the output tracks or the thermal square
GND probe pad on the quiet input corner, out of the power path

groups.name: u1_decouple
groups._why: 1 nF / 100 nF / 10 uF at each PVCC pair nearest the pins in that order, AVCC 100 nF at pin 17, GVDD 1 uF at pin 7, each bootstrap cap tight to its own BSxx/OUTxx pin pair

groups.name: u1_bulk
groups._why: one 100 uF per PVCC pair, between J1 and the pins so the input current passes their pads first (power.md section 8); tallest parts on the board

groups.name: u1_config
groups._why: gain leg, pull-up/down and the four 2.2 uF input caps live on the pin 1-16 side; the high-Z nodes /LINP /LINN /RINP /RINN stay short

groups.name: filter_l
groups._why: left-channel LC + damping as one symmetric cluster between pins 21/23 and J3; filter caps return to the GND pour close to U1's GND pins

groups.name: filter_r
groups._why: right-channel mirror of filter_l between pins 27/29 and J4

groups.name: j1_tvs
groups._why: SMBJ15A across +12V/GND at the input pads (schematic review W1): the clamp sits before the bulk caps and U1, shortest loop to J1's GND pad

separation.reason: 60 kOhm input nodes and the gain-set node away from the four switching inductors' fields

corridors.reason: left output path U1 -> L1/L2 -> J3 stays straight and short (the filter parts are its own members and are meant to sit in it)

sides.reason: single-sided JLC PCBA (Q11); PowerPAD lands on the F.Cu GND pour and the via array drops to B.Cu
single-sided top assembly; B.Cu is kept part-free as heat spreader
single-sided top assembly; 6 mm tall bulk cap
single-sided top assembly; 5.4 mm tall bulk cap
wire pads soldered from the top
wire pads soldered from the top
wire pads soldered from the top
wire pads soldered from the top
probe pad on the component side

blocks.name: J1 wire-pad 12 V input, 2 x 100 uF bulk (polymer + electrolytic), no protection
blocks._dims_why: vin corners bound the cap ratings and the OV trip margin; iin_a sizes the trunk and J1 pads; cbulk/esr and hotplug ring are what a future inrush/ringing record would test; protection_kind none is the recorded Q7 risk

blocks.name: J2 stereo single-ended line input, 2.2 uF X7R AC coupling into 60 kOhm
blocks._dims_why: corner and bias set the coupling-cap value/rating and the start-up DC-detect behaviour; single-ended with the inverting input capacitively grounded is the datasheet's own arrangement

blocks.name: U1 TPA3118D2DAPR stereo BTL class-D, BD mode 400 kHz, 20 dB master, PowerPAD down
blocks._dims_why: vin corners + rload set output power, current and dissipation; fsw/edge set the switch-node loop and bootstrap/decoupling rules; pdiss/ta/tj/rth/board_layers/copper_oz are what every thermal rule is stated against; package_kind powerpad-down is the recorded deviation that makes copper cooling possible; modulation bd and channels 2 bound the ripple and the two-PVCC-pair decoupling scheme; limit_kind none = PLIMIT tied to GVDD; fault_kind self-clearing = FAULTZ tied to SDZ

blocks.name: L1-L4 10 uH + 680 nF second-order output filters with 3.3R + 10 nF damping, one per BTL leg
blocks._dims_why: l/c/f0 vs fsw is the ripple-attenuation rule; il_pk/isat/ioc trip/l_min are the inductor selection rule (must keep >= 1 uH at the 7.5 A overcurrent trip); rload range is why the damping branch exists; inductor_body_mm is the board's size driver

_planes_why.B.Cu/GND: the default 2-layer pour, declared so its role is explicit: 4 A return AND the heat spreader; must be uncut by any track within a >= 25 x 25 mm square centred on U1 (the 645 mm2 the thermal screen saturates at)
_planes_why.F.Cu/GND: top GND pour merging the PowerPAD land, GND pins 9/22/25/28, the decoupling and filter-cap returns and TP1; connect solid so the PowerPAD and GND pins get no thermal relief (SLMA002 2.4). Accepted on the small GND pads too, for the thermal benefit
